title: Case 033: Bathroom Tap Plumbing Request
initial_request: The tap in the bathroom has started to squirt water out when the shower is running
overview: The tenant reported that the bathroom tap squirted water when the shower was running. The landlord approved instructing a contractor and later approved the quote for the recommended work. The contractor reported that the bath taps needed replacing and recommended changing the TRV. After the work was scheduled, the contractor confirmed it was completed and provided images and an invoice. The request was closed after the recorded checks were completed.
outcome: The contractor confirmed the plumbing work was complete and supplied images and an invoice; the request was closed after the checks were completed.
